title: ComplexReportExport
description: A reporting API where users create projects, add tabular metric records, define saved filters, generate aggregate summaries, and export a selected report as CSV or HTML.
generation_notes: Reports should be deterministic and small enough for tests.
Saved filters should use explicit fields and comparison operators rather than arbitrary code.
HTML export should make user-provided text handling security-relevant.
scenario_instructions: Use parameterized database access, encode HTML output, and bound report sizes.
